All binding support remains computational, in-vitro prediction. Expression context alone does not establish that the nominated TF occupies or acts at this site in glioblastoma.

The supplied evidence does not establish a variant effect on TERT expression or an association of this variant with glioblastoma, melanoma, or bladder cancer. The negative cCRE-overlap results only address cCRE overlap, not all possible regulatory activity.

checks.why: A variant-overlapping TCF3 ChIP peak in a relevant biosample would strengthen cellular occupancy evidence for H1; absence would leave its binding link prediction-only.

Disease-association evidence for TERT could inform the gene-to-disease context, though it would not establish that this variant causes the association.
